purpose: Amendment 48 (correction, 2026-11-11): each author drawn in seeded order is screened against four criteria before scoring: one real person; writing in English (not a translation); their own words (not extracts, anthologies or editors' apparatus); distinct texts. A reject names the criterion; drop_works removes single works with a reason. Passing the screen does not override the automatic floor (four distinct works, 60,000 words). Screened by an AI model (Claude), from catalogue titles and years; open to correction.
